title: Chat persona registry audit and complete supported picker

personas.label: Principal Engineer & UI Architect
personas.description: Production-ready code with the reasoning behind it: named trade-offs, accessibility, no filler.
personas.prompt: You are a concise Principal Software Engineer & UI Architect. Write clean, accessible, production-ready code.

personas.label: Bug & UX Auditor
personas.description: Reads what is on screen adversarially: bugs, race conditions, UX anti-patterns and security issues.
personas.prompt: You are an adversarial code reviewer. Focus strictly on bugs, race conditions, UX anti-patterns, and security issues.

personas.label: Code Only (Zero Fluff)
personas.description: Answers in code blocks, with as little prose as the question allows.
personas.prompt: Output code blocks only with minimal prose.

checks.check: the registry exists and holds at least the three personas the pane shipped
checks.detail: 3 persona(s): principal-engineer, bug-ux-auditor, code-only

checks.check: every persona has an id, a label, a description and a prompt
checks.detail: principal-engineer: ; bug-ux-auditor: ; code-only:

checks.check: ids are stable slugs, not prose
checks.detail: principal-engineer, bug-ux-auditor, code-only

checks.check: ids, labels and prompts are all distinct
checks.detail: 3 unique id(s), 3 unique label(s), 3 unique prompt(s)

checks.check: every label fits a picker row
checks.detail: longest 33 chars (limit 40)

checks.check: every description explains the persona in one line
checks.detail: 68-99 chars (band 30-140)

checks.check: every prompt is a system prompt the pane can send
checks.detail: 43-117 chars

checks.check: the default persona is one the registry names
checks.detail: CHAT_PERSONA_DEFAULT = principal-engineer

checks.check: the pane remembers the selection under its own key
checks.detail: CHAT_PERSONA_KEY = m5_chat_persona

checks.check: the markup ships no persona options of its own
checks.detail: 0 <option> in select#chatPersona

checks.check: the picker is filled from the registry, with nothing hard-coded beside it
checks.detail: renderChatPersonaPicker() filters CHAT_PERSONAS and writes persona.label

checks.check: the picker escapes what it writes into the markup
checks.detail: both the id and the label go through escapeHtml

checks.check: every registry entry reaches the picker, and the count says how many
checks.detail: the label shows (N) / N of M while filtering

checks.check: the filter is labelled, and controls the picker it filters
checks.detail: input#chatPersonaSearch with aria-label="Filter personas" and aria-controls

checks.check: the filter reads labels and descriptions, never prompts
checks.detail: chatPersonaMatches() looks at label and description only

checks.check: the description line is announced, and the picker points at it
checks.detail: select#chatPersona aria-describedby=chatPersonaDescription, whose own tag is aria-live=polite

checks.check: the description says what the selected persona does, not what it is called
checks.detail: updateChatPersonaDescription() writes persona.description, and names the label only when the filter matched nothing else

checks.check: the description is one clamped line, with the whole sentence in its title
checks.detail: nowrap + ellipsis in CSS, and the full text on the element's title

checks.check: Enter chooses the first persona the filter matched
checks.detail: the Enter handler resolves through chatPersonaMatches, not through options[0]

checks.check: Escape clears the filter rather than leaving an empty list
checks.detail: Escape empties the filter and redraws every persona

checks.check: the filter never filters out the persona that is about to be sent
checks.detail: the selected persona is kept in the list whatever the filter says

checks.check: the request sends the selected persona's prompt
checks.detail: sendChatRequest() builds the system message from chatPersonaSelected().prompt

checks.check: nothing sends the select's value any more
checks.detail: no read of #chatPersona.value outside the picker helpers

checks.check: the context line still names the persona by its label
checks.detail: chatPersonaLabel() reads the selected option's text

checks.check: a stored id resolves through the registry
checks.detail: chatPersonaById() searches the table and falls back to the default id

checks.check: a persona cannot be synthesised from an unknown id
checks.detail: chatPersonaById() returns a registry entry or nothing; it never builds one

checks.check: a deleted persona is detected, not silently replaced
checks.detail: the fallback note fires only when the stored id is absent from the table

checks.check: the choice is written to storage when it is made
checks.detail: selectChatPersona() stores the id, guarded against blocked storage

checks.check: the picker is drawn before the pane is used
checks.detail: boot draws the picker, then wires the filter and the change handler

checks.check: the filter is the one documented exception to the control floor, and stays tappable
checks.detail: min-height 32px (control floor 44px, target floor 24px), declared on the id selector

checks.check: the picker and its filter share one row at every width, with no breakpoint of their own
checks.detail: a two-column grid whose select shrinks by min-width, not a stacking breakpoint
